title: Cerro Lumen

move.en: Scroll from the dome to the galaxy, one power of ten at a time
move.pt-BR: Role do domo à galáxia, uma potência de dez por vez
move.es: Desplázate del domo a la galaxia, una potencia de diez cada vez

alt: A night sky drawn by a shader over a dark ridge, with a lowercase monospaced headline and a scale rail at the left

title: Maison Orvé

move.en: Compose top, heart and base; watch them move through water
move.pt-BR: Componha topo, coração e fundo e veja-os mover-se na água
move.es: Compón salida, corazón y fondo y míralos moverse en el agua

alt: A serif headline in a narrow column beside a field of gold, violet and green ink threads moving through water

title: Torno

move.en: Pull a pot on the wheel and see what it holds before it is thrown
move.pt-BR: Puxe um vaso no torno e veja quanto ele comporta antes de ser feito
move.es: Levanta una pieza en el torno y mira cuánto contiene antes de hacerla

alt: A celadon-glazed jar rendered in WebGL on terracotta and dark planes beside form chips and sliders

title: Maré

move.en: Contours radiate from the name; raise the wind and the sea builds
move.pt-BR: Contornos irradiam do nome; aumente o vento e o mar cresce
move.es: Los contornos irradian del nombre; sube el viento y el mar crece

alt: A giant condensed wordmark wrapped in cyan and orange contour lines on a deep blue ground

title: Glifo

move.en: Pull five axes by hand, weave a field of letters, open one in depth
move.pt-BR: Puxe cinco eixos com a mão, teça um campo de letras, abra uma em profundidade
move.es: Tira de cinco ejes con la mano, teje un campo de letras, abre una en profundidad

alt: A heavy black and red variable-font headline over five axis sliders on proof paper
